groups.defect: Plural relationship hydration crashes on null values, unconditionally removes raw IDs despite unresolved lookups, produces undefined entries, and can overwrite an existing pluralized field.
groups.rationale: These reports overlap through the unchecked map call and unconditional replacement of ID arrays. The merged comment must also preserve the field-overwrite defect reported by s_d5eddfe5.

groups.defect: Updating or deleting an unknown embeddable host dereferences nil and returns a 500 instead of a 404.
groups.rationale: Both suggestions identify the same unchecked lookups in update and destroy and cover the same required changes.

groups.defect: The test claiming to check absent embeddable hosts actually passes because the unsaved topic has no topic embed.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same misleading test name and ineffective coverage after removal of the production host check.

groups.defect: The host normalization callback calls sub! on nil, raising instead of returning a validation error.
groups.rationale: Both report the same missing nil guard in the same callback; their validation recommendations are alternative fixes.

groups.defect: Host lookup fails for mixed-case incoming hostnames and for stored hosts containing a port because it compares a lowercased stored value with the unnormalized bare URI host.
groups.rationale: All three report the incoming-host case mismatch. s_93eb20ca additionally reports the port mismatch, which must survive in the merged comment.

groups.defect: The migration indexes potentially empty category-setting results and inserts legacy hosts without normalization or SQL quoting, causing migration failures or nonmatching migrated hosts.
groups.rationale: s_c76cedb8 explicitly reports both the empty-result indexing and unsafe, unnormalized host insertion, linking the narrower reports. The combined comment must retain missing-setting handling, host normalization, and SQL quoting.
